Run one round of the master/worker protocol

Source: R/sites.R
master_aggregate.Rd

Backend-agnostic via the master_encrypt() / master_decrypt() generics: works over CKKSMaster, ThresholdMaster, and the legacy PaillierMaster.

Usage

master_aggregate(master, theta)

Arguments

master

a Master, wired to workers via set_workers().

theta

the current parameter value (passed through to each worker's local_fn).

Value

the aggregated value, or NA_real_ on failure.

Details

The master broadcasts theta to each worker. Each worker computes its local summary local_fn(data, theta) and the result is encrypted under the master's public key. The master sums the encrypted contributions homomorphically and decrypts the total.

This is the topology that mirrors how distcomp, DataSHIELD, and similar federated-analysis frameworks actually deploy: a flat fan-out / fan-in. With a single-decrypter master, the master could in principle decrypt individual contributions; the cryptographic guarantee strengthens when paired with threshold key generation (no single party holds the secret key).

If any worker's local_fn returns NA, this function returns NA_real_.
